name: Demo Flight
location_str: Pallas-1 Launch Pad @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: First test launch of Galactic Energy’s Pallas-1 rocket, with a dummy payload on board.
slot_b_text: A sun-synchronous orbit is tilted so the satellite crosses the equator at the same local time on every pass. Shadows fall the same way in every image, which is why almost all Earth-observation satellites use it.
description: First test launch of Galactic Energy’s Pallas-1 rocket, with a dummy payload on board.
rocket_fact: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
